pages.text: Create: Cold Sweat makes Create machines change the temperature of nearby players, so a working factory also heats the room.$(br2)The heat idea itself is in $(l:create_basics/heat)Heat$(/l).
pages.title: What it does
Blaze Burner
pages.text: Warms nearby players. The hotter the flame, the more it adds: smouldering, fading, kindled, seething.

Also counted: $(item)Steam Engines$(), $(item)Encased Fans$(), $(item)Fluid Tanks$(), $(item)Basins$(), pipes and pumps. A working steam boiler radiates more as its level rises. Lava in a container gives heat; water is neutral.
pages.title: Other sources
Encased Fan
pages.text: A fan can take its temperature from the block it faces, so a fan blowing out of a fire or lava can heat a room.
Each effect has a maximum range, so you need to be fairly close. Pipes and tanks only matter when they hold something hot or cold.
pages.title: Range

pages.text: Cold Sweat: Altitude splits the sky into temperature bands by Y, set in its own config file. Entering the sky bands shows a message (Altitude chill, Extreme altitude exposure). Enclosed cover can reduce the effect.
pages.title: Altitude
Protection
pages.text: Altitude adds no items of its own. Armor protection works through item tags that start empty, so nothing in this pack gives it. Shelter can cut the effect: a roof and walls, or an enclosed Aeronautics ship.
Altitude also knows Create Aeronautics ships. Burners and steam vents aboard add heat, and an enclosed ship can shelter you from the chill. See $(l:flight/airships)Airships$(/l).
